info.name: NutrioBox WMS - PACT Webhook
info.description:
Real-time factory-stage events from PACT into the NutrioBox app (KDS / AI Food Inspector).

Endpoint: POST {{base_url}}/api/vouchers/pact-webhook
Auth: header  Authorization: Bearer {{token}}  OR  x-api-key: {{token}}
Body: JSON, one call per event, tagged with an "event" field.
Events: PMR, STOCK_RECEIPT, ISSUE_TO_PRODUCTION, WIP, FG_RECEIPT, SECONDARY.

Set collection variables base_url and token. Sample field names are a template - align them with the field spec before go-live.
